_comment: Coordinated source commits per proxmox-backup release. The client cannot build from crates.io alone: the workspace pins Proxmox crate versions that are unpublished (pathpatterns 1.x, pxar 1.0.1, proxmox-schema 5, ...). We assemble proxmox-backup + 4 sibling repos (which are UNTAGGED) at coordinated commits and enable the [patch.crates-io] path overrides. Sibling commits are chosen by date-match to the release tag and verified to satisfy the required crate versions. See tools/build_source.py.
